description: First-order 1:1 steps among NO3-, NO2-, NH4+ (lumped as NH3) and one unmeasured terminal N product (SINK, N oxidation state 0, i.e. N2/N2O-like), reduction direction only, crossed with three catalyst-state options (none; one deactivation time constant shared by all steps; one activation time constant shared by all steps). This is the model class of scripts/calibrate_liao.py and worlds/W2, made exhaustive.
